by_page a3f60b2713ad.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
by_page a3f60b2713ad.sql:
-- The page each load reported. Samples counts the page loads that
-- reported LCP; each p75 weighs a sample by 1 / sample_rate.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT path, event_name, bucket,
         CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
         count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w
  FROM measures
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
    AND event_name IN ('$lcp', '$inp', '$cls') AND path <> ''
  GROUP BY path, event_name, bucket
),
c AS (
  SELECT path, event_name, samples, approx_value,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY path, event_name ORDER BY bucket) AS run,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY path, event_name) AS total
  FROM h
),
p AS (
  SELECT path, event_name, SUM(samples) AS samples,
         MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.75 * total) AS p75
  FROM c
  GROUP BY path, event_name
)
SELECT path AS "Page",
       COALESCE(MAX(samples) FILTER (WHERE event_name = '$lcp'), 0) AS "Samples",
       ROUND(MAX(p75) FILTER (WHERE event_name = '$lcp')) AS "LCP p75 (ms)",
       ROUND(MAX(p75) FILTER (WHERE event_name = '$inp')) AS "INP p75 (ms)",
       ROUND(MAX(p75) FILTER (WHERE event_name = '$cls'), 3) AS "CLS p75"
FROM p
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
LIMIT 50

cls_p75_by_day 00fb24a8399b.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
cls_p75_by_day 00fb24a8399b.sql:
-- CLS p75 per day: the first bucket whose running weight (1 / sample_rate
-- a sample) reaches 75% of that day's total.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT day, bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
         SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w
  FROM measures
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND event_name = '$cls'
  GROUP BY day, bucket
),
c AS (
  SELECT day, approx_value,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY day ORDER BY bucket) AS run,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS total
  FROM h
)
SELECT day AS x, ROUND(MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.75 * total), 3) AS y
FROM c
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY x

lcp_p75 00af362ddc19.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
lcp_p75 00af362ddc19.sql:
-- p75 of $lcp in the range: the first bucket whose running weight
-- (1 / sample_rate a sample) reaches 75% of the total (docs/reporting.md,
-- "Percentiles from measures"). No row when the range has no samples, so
-- the card is blank rather than a perfect 0. No previous period: stat
-- shows a rise as good, and a vital is better lower.
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
         SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w
  FROM measures
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND event_name = '$lcp'
  GROUP BY bucket),
c AS (SELECT approx_value, SUM(w) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS run, SUM(w) OVER () AS total FROM cur)
SELECT ROUND(MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.75 * total)) AS value
FROM c
HAVING count(*) > 0

metrics 0ab7d2bc8d58.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
metrics 0ab7d2bc8d58.sql:
-- Every metric but the reserved $ ones (the Web Vitals dashboard has
-- those), one row per name and kind. time is in milliseconds, size in
-- bytes, number unitless. A sample weighs 1 / sample_rate. Mean is exact
-- (sum over weight); each percentile is the first bucket whose running
-- weight reaches that share of the total, read as the bucket's value
-- (docs/reporting.md, "Percentiles from measures"), within about 2%.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT event_name, measure, bucket,
         CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
         count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w, SUM(value / sample_rate) AS s
  FROM measures
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
    AND event_name NOT LIKE '$%'
  GROUP BY event_name, measure, bucket
),
c AS (
  SELECT event_name, measure, samples, w, s, approx_value,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY event_name, measure ORDER BY bucket) AS run,
         SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY event_name, measure) AS total
  FROM h
)
SELECT event_name AS "Metric", measure AS "Kind", SUM(samples) AS "Samples",
       ROUND(SUM(s) / SUM(w), 3) AS "Mean",
       ROUND(MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.5 * total), 3) AS "p50",
       ROUND(MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.75 * total), 3) AS "p75",
       ROUND(MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.95 * total), 3) AS "p95"
FROM c
GROUP BY event_name, measure
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 100

not_prefix_leaves_out_every_system_name.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
not_prefix_leaves_out_every_system_name.sql:
SELECT "event_name", count(*), ROUND(SUM(value / sample_rate) / SUM(1 / sample_rate), 3) FROM measures
			WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "event_name" NOT LIKE '$%' GROUP BY "event_name" ORDER BY "event_name"

stat_compare 69e16a8ff86f.sql:
WITH h AS (
		SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
			count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w, SUM(value / sample_rate) AS s
		FROM measures WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-06' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "event_name" = '$cls' GROUP BY bucket),
	c AS (SELECT samples, w, s, approx_value, SUM(w) OVER ( ORDER BY bucket) AS run, SUM(w) OVER () AS total FROM h)
	SELECT SUM(samples), SUM(w), SUM(s) / SUM(w), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.9 * total), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.1 * total) FROM c

weight_and_mean_with_other 736cbf3de253.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
weight_and_mean_with_other 736cbf3de253.sql:
SELECT * EXCLUDE o FROM (SELECT 0 AS o, * FROM (WITH h AS (
		SELECT "event_name", bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
			count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w, SUM(value / sample_rate) AS s
		FROM measures WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "event_name" IN ('$cls', '$inp') GROUP BY "event_name", bucket),
	c AS (SELECT "event_name", samples, w, s, approx_value, SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY "event_name" ORDER BY bucket) AS run, SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY "event_name") AS total FROM h)
	SELECT "event_name", SUM(samples), SUM(w), SUM(s) / SUM(w), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.999 * total), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.05 * total) FROM c GROUP BY "event_name" ORDER BY "event_name")
			UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'Other', * FROM (WITH h AS (
		SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
			count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w, SUM(value / sample_rate) AS s
		FROM measures WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "event_name" NOT IN ('$cls', '$inp', '$foo') GROUP BY bucket),
	c AS (SELECT samples, w, s, approx_value, SUM(w) OVER ( ORDER BY bucket) AS run, SUM(w) OVER () AS total FROM h)
	SELECT SUM(samples), SUM(w), SUM(s) / SUM(w), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.999 * total), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.05 * total) FROM c)) ORDER BY o, 2
